notes: Self-declared as a stage-based parkour game and the difficulty genuinely lives in the geometry — long jumps, tiny platforms, moving platforms, lava — so Obby leads and keeps its P6, with Simulation named second for the pet multipliers, coin and speed progression and the physical shop stations. I considered the '+1 speed' reading that would make this Simulation-first on tier-ladder at P0, but there is no training station, no stat-gated wall and no rebirth pad here; the gate between zones is player skill, so the P6 is earned rather than imported. The answers put all three zones on one continuous floating map walked between in order, which keeps this off P4 despite the zone wording. winner-zone carries each zone's physical reward machine including the Zone 3 OG spawner pad and its 3D countdown, collectible-nodes the timed pet and coin pickups, and social-hub the 3D shop stations that replace the banned 2D menus; the loop was stated as endless, so nothing terminates the run.
